about: Labelled phrasings for the clarify pre-flight (agent/clarify.py). task: the 12 sandbox task requests (sandbox/tasks.json). spec: the ask cases named in the feature request ("Allors towards my bill." is a real clipped voice take). variant / hard_proceed / ask: written by a Claude workflow on 2026-10-17 (three writers: spoken task variants, near-boundary proceed cases, ask cases; then an independent judge labelled every phrasing against the rules and agreed with all 70 labels). The writers never saw the clarify prompt. Replies are recorded by scripts/clarify_eval.py --record.
rules: Ask only if (a) unintelligible or garbled, (b) it would move money or change account/security settings and a required detail is missing ("pay my bill" = the full balance, clear), or (c) it is ambiguous between clearly different actions. Otherwise proceed.
